thesis: LFST is in a confirmed uptrend (close 14.60 above SMA20 13.00, SMA50 12.66, SMA200 9.53) backed by real operating improvement: revenue +25.3% YoY with three sequential increases, positive net income and free cash flow, and low dilution risk. Taking the card's levels (entry 14.20 midpoint, stop 12.85, target 17.0) gives reward/risk of 2.07. The edge is modest: every card scores +1, the regime is risk-off, 15.66 is proven overhead supply and the 11/09 volume driver is unverified, so this rates Overweight on a pullback fill only, not Buy and not a chase at 14.60.
invalidation: A daily close below 12.94 (the 10-day swing low), or a heavy-volume close back under the 13.20 Nov 9 low, invalidates the setup.
key_risks: The 11/09 move (+6% on 29.5M shares, about 6x average) has no verified driver because the news feed was down. A secondary sale, offering or other event cannot be ruled out.
Overhead supply at 15.66: the Nov 5 earnings spike reversed to a 13.43 close. Reward/risk to 15.66 alone is only about 1.1, and the 17.0 target needs a breakout.
The regime is risk-off (confidence 0.8): QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages, 21-day -9.57%, and VIX is rising +37.08%.
The price is extended (RSI 68.6, 12.3% above SMA20), so it may not pull back cleanly into 14.00-14.40, or may fall through it.
Valuation is rich (trailing P/E 81.1, EV/EBITDA 35.5), total debt 475.5M exceeds cash 218.8M, and the profit margin is only 4.3%.
